children: Qt Group Plc | Stock Exchange Release | October 19, 2026 at 9:30 am EEST
Qt Group Plc will publish its Financial Statements Bulletin, Annual Report, two Interim Statements and Half-Year Report in 2027 as follows (all times in EET/EEST):
Financial Statements Bulletin 2026: Thursday, February 18, 2027, at approximately 1 pm
Annual Report 2026: Thursday, March 11, 2027, at approximately 8 am
Interim Statement January-March 2027: Friday, April 23, 2027, at approximately 8 am
Half-Year Report January-June 2027: Wednesday, August 4, 2027, at approximately 1 pm
Interim Statement January-September 2027: Tuesday, October 26, 2027, at approximately 8 am
Qt Group Plc's Annual General Meeting is planned to be held on Tuesday, April 6, 2027. The Board of Directors of Qt Group Plc will convene the meeting at a later date.
Mika Pälsi, General Counsel, Qt Group Plc

title: Qt Group Plc's financial reporting in 2027
